name: fleet
summary: Validates and manages owned local QEMU practice nodes and their optional AAP registration.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses owned node metadata, overlays, and AAP records when they exist.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before VM creation or AAP registration when image, virtualization, SSH, or controller prerequisites fail.

readiness: Each selected node has verified SSH access.
Registered nodes pass the AAP ad-hoc ping check.

security.secret_storage: The shared Fleet SSH private key is stored in the encrypted credential Vault.
security.network_trust: SSH trust uses the configured local-lab or fingerprint-verification mode.
security.external_actions: Image download and optional registration require explicit configured entitlement access.
